title: gastify: scan → cooked
card: gastify's line assembled from two reusable components — the intake line and the kitchen loop — each embeddable on its own in any doc page. The domain shapes (standing state, side input, feedback edge) live in the second. Numbers illustrative.
lede: Eight machines take a photographed receipt to a cooking event and back into a proficiency score — served here as two self-contained components any page in this center can embed with one token. The shape is gastify's; the numbers are invented for this example, and the measured page belongs in gastify's own command center once the suite propagates there.
handle: The seam between the two components is one named payload — the intake line ends on "a confirmed transaction" and the kitchen loop consumes exactly that. A component whose boundary is a named payload composes; one whose boundary is "and then the rest happens" does not.
source: structure from the gastify domain; NUMBERS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE — invented for this example by operator ruling (2026-08-01), never measured. This page teaches the suite's grammar; it is not a status page for gastify and does not update when gastify changes.
